# Markapur Taxi

Markapur Taxi provides passenger taxi services from Markapur Road Railway Station and Markapur town to Srisailam, plus return journeys, vehicle rentals, group travel and local travel guidance.

## Primary services
- Markapur Road Railway Station to Srisailam taxi
- Srisailam to Markapur taxi
- Maruti Swift Dzire, Toyota Innova, Innova Crysta and Mahindra Xylo rentals
- Force Trax Toofan AC for group travel
- Railway station pickup and hotel transfer

- Bengaluru to Srisailam travel planning via Markapur Road railway station

## Contact
- Phone: +91 94913 20241
- Website: https://www.markapurtaxi.com/
- Online booking: https://www.markapurtaxi.com/book

## Important information
Fares, vehicle availability, railway schedules, temple timings, forest-entry rules and hotel availability can change. Visitors should confirm current details before travel.
